localDraftReviewNotes: 11:21 keeps ב[פת]ע and ל[העשיר דל] bracket extents, now corrected from the wider first-draft bracket.
11:24 brackets enclose ומ only; 11:25 has visible opening brackets before ורעת and ואחרית; unmatched source brackets are not silently balanced.
11:28 bracket spans both poetic halves from תאש[רהו through באחריתו]; ינכר includes the nun omitted in the first draft.

Bracket movement preserves Hebrew grapheme clusters: the existing sheva of shin in תאש is encoded before the opening bracket, not as a combining mark attached to punctuation. Parent review identified the structural issue; the point itself is neither added nor removed.

subsequentReview.basis: Clearer independent extra scan, spread241 right; separate primary agent comparison and independent parent confirmation. resolutions.evidence: Both scans show a short resh roof in the third position, with no lamed ascender; only the final lamed rises. The user original בגרל was correct.
Both scans contain exactly five glyphs mem–nun–tsadi–vav–final tsadi, with no separate yod. The user original מנצוץ was correct.
